i) Press Release announcing Sony Corporation Statement regarding Media Reports dated June 7, 2011.

 
 
 
 
 
Sony Corporation Statement regarding Media Reports dated June 7, 2011
 
TOKYO, June 7, 2011----Certain media reports were published on June 7, 2011 about a possible transaction between Sony Corporation (“Sony”), the Innovation Network Corporation of Japan and Toshiba Corporation regarding the companies’ small- and medium-sized LCD panel businesses.  Sony has made no announcement in this regard and has no comment.
